statement.conclusion: GX.exists_gxQuotientCircle: L : Type with ChartedSpace X L, HasGroupoid L (gxGroupoid G X), IsCircle L; pi : R -> L continuous on J, open on J, pi '' J = univ, fibres on J the <f>-orbits (exists n : N, f^[n] x = y or f^[n] y = x); D developing along pi on J; psi : R -> J continuous, strictly increasing, onto J, psi 0 = x0, psi (s+1) = f (psi s); E = pi o psi a periodic covering along which D o psi develops; holonomy D (psi (s+1)) = gamma . D (psi s); uniqueness of the structure up to maximal atlas among those along which D o psi develops

with D = linkCover p theta ((isCoveringMap_linkCover p theta).isLocalHomeomorph) and f = delta^2 * g (g the lift of A with a fixed point): hlt from GTilde.sub_one_lt_apply_of_fixed, hDf from linkCover_add_two_mul. `obtain <L, _, cs, hcs, hL, E, psi, hE, hpsic, hpsim, hpsif, hdev> := ...` then C := <p, cs, hcs, hL> (C.pt = p by rfl) and C.IsLiftedDev theta E psi f := <hE, hpsic, hpsim, hdev, hpsif> (verified in /tmp: both examples compile). Not done here (outside this file): the choice of A in Gamma_p minus 1 (a boost, kb 0053), its lift with a fixed point, and the positive/negative signs (spacelike_dichotomy, sign of g vs g^-1 on I+, GTilde.IsHyperbolic.exists_conj_inv for f' = kappa f kappa^-1)

findings: l.721-722 'every cyclic subgroup of G~ is the holonomy group of a real projective circle' is false for the trivial subgroup: an RP1-circle's lifted developing map is increasing with D (s+1) = f (D s), so f != 1 (GX.not_hasLiftedHolonomy_one; GX.not_every_cyclic_subgroup_is_holonomy refutes the printed group form). The paper's own proof says 'rho(1) is non-trivial' (l.718). Smallest correction: 'every non-trivial cyclic subgroup' (proved: GX.exists_rp1Circle_zpowers). HSSingularities' docstring of GX.exists_rp1Circle_of_ne_one already states the corrected form without recording it as a finding.
questions: l.690-691 'non-trivial elliptic elements act on RP~1 as translations, i.e. freely and properly discontinuously': read topologically, as the paper's 'i.e.' glosses it. Proved stronger than free and properly discontinuous: every element of G~ without fixed point is conjugate, by an increasing homeomorphism of R, to s -> s + 1 or s -> s - 1 (GX.GTilde.exists_conj_translation). The projective reading (conjugate in G~ to the lift of a rotation, which acts on RP~1 = R by a translation t -> t + c) is the rotation normal form of T-bbs-psl2-normal-forms, not proved here.

'naturally a real projective structure' (l.692, l.700): read as the structure for which the projection is a (G,X)-morphism from the structure pulled back along the developing map (GX.gxQuotient), unique up to maximal atlas; the uniqueness is part of GX.exists_gxQuotientCircle.
kb_proposals: A quotient circle J/<f> (J an interval, f an increasing homeomorphism of J, x < f x) is GX.exists_gxQuotientCircle: it conjugates f to s -> s + 1 by a fundamental domain psi : R -> J (GX.exists_reparam_conj_add_one: f as an Equiv.Perm J via BijOn.equiv, psi s = (F ^ floor s) (x0 + fract s * (f x0 - x0))), then builds R/Z with the structure of D o psi (GX.exists_gxQuotient_add_one: Multiplicative Z acting by GX.addIntAction through letI, GX.gxQuotient, Orbits ~ Circle by Quotient.lift RP1.proj and Equiv.toHomeomorphOfContinuousOpen).

To return a (Gamma_p, l(p))-circle with C.pt = p from an existential, return its fields (cs, hcs, hL) and state (GammaLinkCircle.mk p cs hcs hL).IsDevAlong E d: D : R -> Link p then typechecks, and the consumer builds C := <p, cs, hcs, hL> with C.pt = p by rfl (GX.exists_gammaLinkCircle_quotient_of_forall_lt).
